column1: # release-roster.tsv — the models the release gate MUST run, and where they live.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. docs/RELEASING.md used to say `run-gen <each affected model>`,
# and "affected" was left to the releaser's judgment. On 2026-08-28 that judgment
# skipped ornith-1.5-35b-a3b for v0.118.0 — the reasoning was defensible (a
# JSON-emission change touches no kernel) but the model is OURS, self-published, the
# one nobody else serves, and it was skipped because its GGUF simply was not on the
# rig. A gate you can satisfy by not having the file is not a gate.
# OWNER RULING 2026-08-28: "the main models that need to be tested are my models."
# An `own` model is REQUIRED — release-battery.sh refuses a release when one is
# missing rather than reporting it skipped. A `vendor` model is required when present
# and reported absent when not: we do not publish other people's checkpoints, so a
# missing vendor file is a rig-provisioning fact, not a custody failure.

column4: self-published NVFP4+MTP (HF Avifenesh/Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B-NVFP4-MTP-GGUF); the only endpoint serving it anywhere
